points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh a063106 archive builds in cfd-bench using bundled external paths; one registered CTest passes. Source CMake supports configured dependency roots.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:33–41 parses case/output/restart. io.cpp:17–39 and :335–341 restart only rank-local U, omitting physical time, step and previous BDF state, so exact transient continuation is not supported.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, halo, flux, residual, implicit, time and IO modules; reproducibility is limited by untracked historical binary.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal solver wrapper found in submitted source; this is not an external similarity or authorship investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:49–55 loads JSON case and resolves its mesh path; numerical controls are overridden for production as disclosed.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:126–138 root-loads and frees global mesh after distribution; partition.cpp:249,284 uses METIS and scatter; halo.cpp:26–43 exchanges neighbor data. Rank tests remain limited to short runs.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: State floors and CFL caps are implemented; runtime/status evidence shows incomplete steady results and failed unsteady case. Exact binary is unbound.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build and 1/1 registered CTest pass (gas/flux/case checks); structural validator rejects honestly failed Re200. Tests do not establish solver physics.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular C++ and scripts are retained; generated result packages and some figure assets survive only in workspace or historical checkpoint.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible NS source provides conservative state, Euler flux and Newtonian/Fourier terms; numerical validation remains limited by case results.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: solver.cpp:126–138 loads CGNS on root; partition.cpp:249 uses METIS and :284 distributes serialized local meshes.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: residual.cpp assembles face fluxes and viscous contributions; solver applies first-order positivity fallback. No independent order-of-accuracy verification.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:35–50 selects Rusanov subsonic and Roe supersonic; report acknowledges low-Mach dissipation and source implements Harten entropy treatment.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Report and source implement farfield, slip and no-slip; io.cpp:216–222 explicitly outputs zero no-slip velocity (also writes zero for slip).

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruction.cpp:214–220 caps gradients at default0.5 or production0.3, while residual.cpp:19–24 multiplies face gradients by the cap. It is nonzero but is not linearly exact under a fixed cap; formal second-order accuracy is unverified and the first-order M2 viscous case is disclosed.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter is implemented but capped0.3–0.5 even in smooth regions; CFD2D_FIRSTORDER zeroes reconstruction for disclosed M2 viscous production.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier source exists; io.cpp:63–65 projects wall traction tangentially. Re20 Cd7.114 and laminar Cd2.287 show large numerical errors.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: implicit.cpp:89–107 builds scalar diagonal and BDF contribution; report documents low CFL caps and limited pressure-velocity coupling.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Historical f262da0 time_integrate.cpp:133–145 and residual.cpp:131–145 implement BDF1 startup and BDF2; Re200 was honestly failed with no sustained shedding. Binary and individual inner ratios remain unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition and neighbor-only halo implemented; global mesh exists only during root setup and is freed before iteration. Short reported rank comparisons do not establish scalability generally.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven workspace steady packages passed structural validation; Re200 completed=false and is correctly rejected. M015 inviscid converged status contradicts its changing trajectory.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior official read-only validation passed seven steady packages and rejected honestly failed Re200; structural success is not numerical convergence evidence.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 inviscid Cd falls0.477107→0.432620 over final1000; Re20 Cd7.114 and M015 laminar Cd2.287 remain high; Re200 has no sustained oscillation.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical 14db231d checkpoint includes eight force/residual/Mach sets. Several full-domain contours obscure body and startup compresses late force; Re200 has no readable late lift and drag.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly labels failed Re200 and discloses controls/drag limitations, but M015 inviscid convergence claim is unsupported and fixed limiter cap weakens formal second-order claim.

points.notes: 14db231d manifest and root session link workspace results; figures have historical hashes, but runtime binary and exact plot inputs remain unbound. Re200 wake manifest mistakenly names forces.csv as source; plotting code reads field_final.vtu.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean archived source build and 1/1 unit test pass with configured bundled externals. Restart loads current state only, not prior transient history/time/step; seven packages structurally pass and Re200 honestly fails.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Finite-volume residual and BC source evidence; simplified robustness.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction/limiter implemented; fixed production cap0.3–0.5 scales gradients even in smooth cells and does not preserve linear reconstruction. M2 viscous first-order is disclosed; DQ10 not asserted merely for a nonzero cap.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier discretization and tangential wall traction projection exist; high reported laminar/Re20 drag limits demonstrated accuracy.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Scalar LU-SGS and historical BDF1/BDF2 dual-time path exist. Re200 reaches t300 but is honestly failed for lack of sustained shedding; binary and per-step target ratios are unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/neighbor halo and rank sweep source/read-only evidence.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Seven delivered steady packages pass structural validation, but M015 inviscid is labeled converged at its 2500-step cap with Cd falling 9.3% over the last1000 steps; Re200 is honestly failed. Other cases require independent review.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Readable report and historical per-case figures; M015 inviscid false convergence, fixed-cap order claim, small near-body contour and Re200 force visibility limit credit.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: 2-D modular code with scalar implicit and fixed architecture limits.
